consent.autoDescription:
Sign-in needs a session cookie from {origin}.

Click Allow for a one-tap browser prompt — manual steps follow if it doesn't appear.

Used only for sign-in and sessions. No tracking, no analytics.
consent.manualDescription:
Your browser is blocking the session cookie from {origin}.

Follow the steps below, then click "I've enabled it" and sign in again.
consent.declinedBanner: Cookie access is required to sign in.
consent.loginCookieMissing: Sign-in succeeded but the session cookie did not reach this browser. Follow the cookie-access steps and try again.
consent.learnMoreBody:
Browsers block cross-site cookies by default to prevent tracking, which also blocks our session cookie.

You can allow it just for this site, and revert it anytime from your browser settings.

safari.0: Safari does not provide a per-site cookie exception. The available toggle is browser-wide.
safari.1: Open Safari → Settings (⌘ + ,) → Privacy and uncheck "Prevent cross-site tracking" while you sign in.
safari.2: Reload this page and sign in. You can re-enable that toggle afterward — your session will continue.
safari.3: If you prefer not to change Safari's setting, sign in once using Chrome, Edge, or Firefox instead.

firefox.0: Click the <shield></shield> in Firefox's address bar on this page.
firefox.1: Turn off Enhanced Tracking Protection for this site only (do not change global settings).
firefox.2: Reload this page and sign in. You can re-enable protection from the same <shield></shield> afterward.

chromium.0: Click the eye or cookie icon at the right side of the address bar on this page.
chromium.1: Choose "Allow cookies" (or "Allow third-party cookies") for this site only.
chromium.2: Reload this page and sign in.

generic.0: Open your browser's site-settings panel for this page (often via the icon at the right of the address bar).
generic.1: Add an exception that allows cookies from {origin} on this site only — avoid disabling browser-wide privacy settings.
generic.2: Reload this page and sign in.
